title: Convergence Demand Queue
purpose: Machine-readable mirror of the Section-4 demand-queue table in convergence_demand_pipeline_plan.md. Each row maps an OPEN closure node whose latest verdict is 'mechanism unclear' or 'substrate ceiling' to the external AI-assembly project whose solution maps onto its mechanism gap, plus the intake action that terminates in REGISTERED candidate claims (never survey prose). The Sense step (plan Section 5 step 1, wired into /governance Step 6b) appends rows here; the Mine/Register steps execute them per row.

invariants.registers_claims_not_prose: Every executed row terminates in >=1 version-scoped candidate claim wired into the target node's depends_on with an arch-doc stub. 'Future-registration' prose is a pipeline failure.
invariants.v3_primacy: A row whose external mechanism maps onto a V4/V5-leaning substrate is tagged generation: v4_leaning|v5_leaning and MUST NOT place a build dependency on the v3 critical path (blocks_v3_critical_path stays false on every row). The pipeline surfaces ideas; it does not reprioritise v3.
invariants.biology_before_formal_definitions: Where an external mechanism instantiates a formal concept REE will own as an SD/MECH, commission a biology /lit-pull before registering.

intake_state_legend.NEW: no intake exists in REE_convergence yet
intake_state_legend.PARTIAL: an intake exists at the named sources/<name>/ path; extend it along the stated angle
intake_state_legend.COMPLETED: intake done; pull the adapter through to a registered claim
intake_state_legend.IN_FLIGHT: a row currently being executed by a chip/session (see in_flight pointer)

generation_legend.v3: mechanism maps onto existing V3 substrate / V3 claims; on the V3 work surface
generation_legend.v4_leaning: registers candidate claims tagged generation:v4 (preparatory only; off the v3 critical path)
generation_legend.v5_leaning: registers candidate claims tagged generation:v5 (preparatory only; off the v3 critical path)
